title: Mwandila v Phiri (Appeal 182 of 2013) [2022] ZMSC 47 (26 May 2022)
issue_tags: Order 113 RSC (summary possession) limited to dispossessing trespassers; contentious ownership disputes require full trial or conversion under Order 28(8) RSC; procedural irregularities generally cureable under Order 2 RSC but not where misuse subverts the purpose of a special procedure; certificate of title issues cannot be resolved by summary procedure.
outcome_detail: Summary possession under Order 113 RSC cannot resolve disputed title; matter remitted for full trial under Order 28(8) RSC
